summary: Aptevo Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that its multispecific platform will be presented at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer (SITC) 2026 Annual Meeting, held November 4-8, 2026, at the Phoenix Convention Center. The accompanying press release describes CD40-directed multispecific molecules designed to coordinate innate and adaptive immunity within the tumor microenvironment. No financial terms, transactions, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary product-science disclosure, not a special situation, with no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
